purpose: Define a bounded, outcome-blind negative-evidence contract for MSCI Global Standard Taiwan membership additions/deletions without claiming broad passive-flow absence.

sourceContract.internalCompletenessInvariant: For each validated cycle, Taiwan summary added/deleted counts must equal parsed Taiwan country-section counts. Any mismatch => SOURCE_INCOMPLETE_OR_SCHEMA_DRIFT.
sourceContract.firstKnownRule: Use provider publication timestamp when auditable. If only a publication date is trustworthy, fail closed and do not make the event PIT-eligible until the next Taiwan trading session after the publication date.
sourceContract.revisionRule: Preserve source artifact identity/version; later provider knowledge must not rewrite an earlier Formal generation.

allowedState.name: NO_MSCI_STANDARD_MEMBERSHIP_ADD_DELETE_VERIFIED
allowedState.meaning: Within a validated MSCI Global Standard review cycle and frozen membership-event window, complete Taiwan add/delete artifact coverage contains no applicable membership add/delete for the symbol.

excludedCoverage: MSCI weight-only changes not exposed by the public add/delete list
MSCI Small Cap/Micro Cap and other MSCI index families unless separately validated
unscheduled/special index actions unless separately captured

licenseAndUseGuard.reason: The public MSCI PDF includes use restrictions covering derivative/database/analytics uses. This receipt validates a research source contract only and does not authorize bulk extraction, database construction, production analytics ingestion, redistribution, or commercial use.
licenseAndUseGuard.implementationRule: Before any automated persistent constituent archive or production join, use an appropriately licensed/authorized source or obtain a permission determination. Do not infer authorization from public URL accessibility.

falsification: Four consecutive validated review cycles support a stable bounded artifact pattern, but four cycles do not prove perpetual future schema stability.
A complete add/delete list cannot rule out weight-only passive demand.
A symbol absent from the list cannot be called ordinary active flow; at most membership-add/delete contamination is excluded for this provider/index scope.
Publication-date availability must not be shifted earlier for Taiwan decisions.
If provider artifact is missing, revised without preserved vintage, count-invariant fails, or access/licensing is unresolved, state remains EVENT_COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE.
exactNext: Use this only as a bounded semantic control. Audit whether an authorized/licensed source can supply the same PIT membership-event receipt prospectively. Separately continue weight-change/other-index/ETF-flow source coverage. Do not label institutional flow ORDINARY_FLOW_CONTEXT_VERIFIED until the broader passive-event universe is complete.
